name: BFL Asset Finvest Limited
about: BFL Asset Finvest Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company provides securities investments and trading, negotiable instruments, and inter corporate loans. It also engages in shares, interest income, futures, options, and other finances. The company was formerly known as BFL Developers Limited and changed its name to BFL Asset Finvest Limited in November 2017. BFL Asset Finvest Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Jaipur, India.
